name: Camoufox
description: Official anti-detect Firefox Playwright WebSocket server built on python:3.12-slim (daijro/camoufox) with C++ fingerprint spoofing, persistent /config cache, optional WS_TOKEN auth, slim fonts pruning, GeoIP matching, and OS/locale/WebRTC/image controls for Playwright, Node-RED, and n8n.
short_desc: Official anti-detect Firefox Playwright WebSocket server
author: daijro

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: camoufox (if left blank, falls back to camoufox).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: WS_TOKEN
form_fields.hint: Optional authentication token required for Playwright WebSocket connections and /json discovery on port 9223. Leave blank to allow unauthenticated local access.

form_fields.label: HEADLESS
form_fields.hint: Browser display mode. Virtual Display runs Camoufox inside its built-in Xvfb display; Native Headless runs without Xvfb. Default: virtual.

form_fields.label: SLIM_FONTS
form_fields.hint: Prune large (>5 MB) CJK and Apple Emoji font files inside /config/.cache after browser download to save ~1.6 GB of disk space (true or false). Leave blank to keep all fonts.

form_fields.label: GEOIP
form_fields.hint: Automatically derive geolocation, timezone, and locale from the public IP or proxy exit IP (true or false). Leave blank to keep disabled.

form_fields.label: OS_TARGET
form_fields.hint: Target OS family used for fingerprint generation (windows, macos, or linux). Leave blank to randomize across all supported OS families.

form_fields.label: LOCALE
form_fields.hint: Browser locale or comma-separated locales (e.g. pt-BR,en-US). Leave blank to use the generated fingerprint locale.

form_fields.label: BLOCK_IMAGES
form_fields.hint: Block image loading to reduce bandwidth usage (true or false). Leave blank to load images normally.

form_fields.label: BLOCK_WEBRTC
form_fields.hint: Block WebRTC completely (true or false). Leave blank to keep default WebRTC fingerprint spoofing.

form_fields.label: DISABLE_COOP
form_fields.hint: Disable Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy for interacting with cross-origin iframes (true or false). Leave blank to keep default.

form_fields.label: shm_size
form_fields.hint: Shared memory (/dev/shm) size for Camoufox. Leave blank to use the default (1gb).
